doc: What Frank's face engine (frank/engine, docs/FACE_ENGINE.md) offers a chart, as frank/statechart/bridge.py connects them: the events it sends, the context it updates every tick, the actions it carries out and the profiles its animator knows.

profiles.idle: nobody engaged: look-around fixations, slower with boredom; ~17 blinks/min
profiles.person: someone in view but not engaged: a glance at them now and then
profiles.greeting: he has just engaged someone: eyes on their face with eye-eye-nose saccades, brows up, eyes wide
profiles.listening: the visitor is talking: mostly on them, a sideways look ~1.1 s every ~7 s, blinks after their pauses
profiles.thinking: their turn ended and the reply is being written: eyes up and away ~3.5 s, back as his audio starts
profiles.speaking: his audio plays: on them, away ~2 s every ~5 s, ~26 blinks/min at phrase ends
profiles.interrupted: barge-in: snap to the speaker, reflex blink, brow flinch
profiles.farewell: someone left: follow them out, hold, one slow blink

events.session_end: nobody engaged for 20 s: the conversation is over
events.moved: he is being picked up or carried (the view swings)
events.still: he has been set down again
events.dark: his vision went black (covered, or the lights are off)
events.hearing: partial words of the visitor's line are coming in
events.visitor: the visitor's line is complete: his reply is being written
events.frank_end: his reply has finished (data: silent, interrupted)
events.interrupted: the visitor talked over him and his voice was cut
events.chuckle: his reply has a [chuckle] in it
events.new: a new conversation was started from the page or the terminal

speaking.doc: his voice is playing (a voice slice within the last 0.45 s)

thinking.doc: the visitor's turn is over and his reply hasn't started playing

people.doc: people in view (printed faces and posters not counted)

present.doc: a conversation session is open, or someone is engaged (within 2 m and facing him)

no_vision.doc: no vision snapshot (no camera, --no-see, or the camera stopped)

tag.doc: show an expression: the synthesiser feels it (synth.feel), one tag at a time with a 1.2 s minimum hold

nudge.doc: push the mood (synth.nudge) in pleasure, arousal and dominance

anim.doc: a one-shot animator event this tick

raise.doc: send an event to this chart (now, or after delay seconds)

set.doc: set a context variable from a value or an expression

log.doc: write a line to the engine log
